reviewRole: fresh independent read-only challenge of final composed source

findings.title: Revalidate enterprise decision and offering authorization during production
findings.impact: A current execution permit can continue executing a production decision whose separate controller has been revoked. The active support callback rechecks the prototype but not its decision signer or decision expiry; persisted authorized-offering signatures are also not checked at decision/dispatch. No forging or journal mutation is required.

counterexample.control: Revoke the separate decision signer before dispatch: ValueError and zero model calls.
counterexample.attack: Revoke the same signer after the first model response while the independent execution-permit signer remains current: subsequent local tool action and second model call still execute; result reports delivered-awaiting-independent-acceptance-and-costs.

findings.suggestedCorrection: Reverify the exact enterprise decision signature and its current expiry inside the per-run active support check, including production and prototype; validate the offering authorization support at decision and dispatch according to the intended current-authority contract. Keep failed attempts, liability and capacity reserved.

commands.result: Three revocation timings complete production despite the authorized offering signer no longer being currently trusted.
Before-dispatch revocation refuses; in-flight decision-signer revocation permits one later tool action and second model response.
